hypothesis.name: Half-Step Forward Continuation
hypothesis.statement: Reducing the forward displacement increment by 50% (from Delta u = 17.8 nm to Delta u = 8.899 nm, reaching midpoint target u_RP = 0.001938410627 mm) reduces damage evolution per loading step and allows the original unaccelerated AM/PDAS algorithm to reach stationary equilibrium before the onset of noncontractive iterations on Candidate C4.

predeclared_stationarity_rules.midpoint_evaluation_rule: Midpoint is a diagnostic step. If stationarity is achieved within 25 cycles with 0 healing violations, free residual <= 1e-6, and active multiplier >= -1e-9, classify H15_PASSED_MIDPOINT. Donor Increment-87 energy acceptance is not directly applied to the midpoint.
